name: business-card
description: The fluorokit type scale for a printed business card (US, 3.5 x 2 in). The web scale in rem, at 8 pt to the rem: 1rem of body is 8 pt. Leading keeps the web ratio, except body, which is tighter for short lines. Tracking is in InDesign units (1/1000 em). Light weight only from 12 pt (1.5rem), as on the web. Nothing smaller than 6 pt.

card.note: The left edge is the page margin of the web: every text frame starts on it. Type that bleeds (hero) runs past the trim on the right.

hero.use: One word that bleeds off the trim, back of the card. 8rem: larger than the web hero, so the word runs past the right edge.
hero.case-source: WP7 p.194: lowercase for page titles. Zune p.26: Segoe Light lowercase for sub-headlines and UI.

title.case-source: WP7 p.194: lowercase for page titles. A name keeps its own case only if it has one.

heading.case-source: WP7 p.194: lowercase for list titles and list group titles.

subheading.case-source: WP7 p.194: sentence caps for status and explanatory text.

body.case-source: Zune p.26: regular upper and lowercase for body copy.

label.case-source: WP7 p.194: sentence caps for labels.

overline.use: The label over a group: CONTACT, WEB
overline.case-source: WP7 p.194: all caps for application titles. Zune p.26: regular uppercase for titles. Set in the font case, not with a style.

data.case-source: An email or a URL stays as written. A date or a time is all caps (WP7 p.194: all caps for dates, times, AM and PM).

color.text: Type of 9 pt and smaller prints in 100% black (K only), not in the text color: four inks cannot hold registration on 6-8 pt type. The text color is for 12 pt and up.
color.accent: Decoration only, as on the web: the energy bar and rules. No type in it.

case-rules.lower: every letter lowercase, typed that way, never set by a style
case-rules.sentence: a capital on the first word and on proper nouns only
case-rules.title case: not used. Zune p.28: do not mix upper and lowercase words in a sentence.
case-rules.mixed: one case for each line. Zune p.28: do not jumble upper and lowercase letters in a word, and do not mix colors or fonts in a word.
